text:
elaine (FinOps): Quick flag: Saffron Health renewal invoice INV-2028-312 includes full platform fee but they were on a pilot discount (50% platform fee) for Jan-Jun 2028 per PromoAddendum PA-9. We need a retroactive true-up/discount and corrected invoice before close.
raj (Billing): can you paste invoice lines?
elaine (FinOps): PDF snippet:
INV-2028-312
Line 7: Platform Fee - Period 01Jan2028-31Dec2028 - $200,000
Line 14: Support Tier Gold - Period 01Jul2028-30Jun2029 - $24,000
Line 22: Promo credit - Amount: $0

marta (CS): Customer moved from pilot to standard private deployment on 2028-07-01. PromoAddendum PA-9 (signed 2028-01-05) gave 50% platform fee for first 6 months. They expect the credit reflected.
sam (Sales): Confirmed. Sales ops ticket SO-3309 requested billing acknowledgment in Jan. Looks like it didn't apply.
raj (Billing): Reproducing — billing pipeline ignored PA-9 because promo type 'pilot_discount' wasn't mapped to proration rules in the renewals job. I'll file BE-7150.
billing-bot: New issue BE-7150 created: "promo type unmapped -> pilot discounts not applied at renewal" assigned to billing-engine. https://issues.redwood/BE-7150
elaine (FinOps): We need a manual credit for the six-month pilot: calculation = platform fee 200k * 50% * 6/12 = $50,000 credit. Include promo addendum id PA-9 and SO-3309.
raj (Billing): I'll draft credit memo for $50k and corrected invoice reflecting $150k platform fee for 2028 (i.e., 200k - 50k credit). Routing to Ava for approval.
ava (Finance Lead): I approve the $50k manual adjustment. Please include audit note referencing PA-9, sign date, and a clear month-based calc.
marta (CS): I'll notify customer that this is a retroactive billing correction and that their renewal terms otherwise unchanged.
raj (Billing): Will attach PA-9 PDF and SO-3309 to the memo. ETA draft credit + updated invoice by EOD, final tomorrow AM after sign-off.
billing-bot: BE-7150 update: triage complete, mapping fix planned; backfill scheduled for next billing run.
elaine (FinOps): Thanks. Once credit posts, I'll reconcile revenue ledger and confirm renewal communication. Please ping when BE-7150 backfill completes so we can verify no other pilots missed credits. :white_check_mark:
